summary: Brother of John's grandfather James C. Meier (John's great-uncle).
bio:
Son of William F. Meier and Florence L. Pringle; 'William, son, about 3' in the 1930 Wilkes-Barre census (55 Cedar St) and 'William Jr., son, 23' in the 1950 census (house 55, ED 40-102). Nothing further recorded.

The FamilySearch tree links William Jr. (d. 29 Feb 2004) to a wife, Nancy Anne Stahl Meier. She died on 13 May 2009 at Clermont, Florida ([R4-S1]). The tree also cites a NUMIDENT entry for him and an obituary from the 'United States, Obituary Records, 2014–2023' collection, but both source images returned HTTP 404 from the public endpoint, so neither was read.
